decisions.title: It's Debrief, and RaceCap is separate
decisions.text: The tool was renamed from RaceCap to Debrief. Swazi's own RaceCap app is never touched; Debrief only reads RaceCap's race folders.

decisions.title: Garage 61 only when you click; the token is never shown
decisions.text: Debrief never polls Garage 61 in a loop, and the token is never printed, logged or committed. It is stored encrypted.

decisions.title: Coaching says what tended to happen, not what caused it
decisions.text: Advice is correlational: patterns in your laps, not proof of cause.

decisions.title: Friends use their own Garage 61 tokens, no OAuth
decisions.text: No Garage 61 sign-in flow and no emails: each driver requests a personal token.

decisions.title: Nothing is published without "publish"
decisions.text: Every release waits for Swazi's explicit word. Never force-push.

decisions.title: Discord posts are confirmed every time
decisions.text: Debrief never posts for you without a confirm.

decisions.title: Keep the Overdriver Academy Garage 61 app as it is
decisions.text: The personal API app stays registered where it is.

decisions.title: Debrief is free, forever
decisions.text: No paywall, including Setup Lab. Licence: free to use, all rights reserved, Black Magik Studios.

decisions.title: Team features are generic
decisions.text: Teams and members come only from your own Garage 61 teams. No team names or people are built in.

decisions.title: Every verdict must beat a shuffle test
decisions.text: A tip or verdict is shown only when it holds up on your own laps (permutation tests). Overclaims found by reviewers were fixed.

decisions.title: Keep credits low
decisions.text: Sonnet builds, Haiku tests, Opus only for statistics reviews; one helper at a time where possible.

decisions.title: Endurance reads iRacing, not Garage 61
decisions.text: Fuel, pit service and swaps come from iRacing's own live data; Garage 61 has no fuel data.

decisions.title: Siyanqaba out of Debrief until it's finished
decisions.text: The Siyanqaba link and the Cncava server integration are on hold; the code was taken out in 2.30.3.

decisions.title: Every update ships a What's new
decisions.text: Plain words for drivers first, then For the record with Not proven yet. The build checks it.

decisions.title: Analysis, prep and practice are the core
decisions.text: No new voice, mic or recording work. The coach stays and gets integrated with a full guide.

decisions.title: Telemetry is only ever turned on
decisions.text: Make iRacing save my telemetry is off until ticked and never turns telemetry off.

decisions.title: No token needed; Garage 61 is optional
decisions.text: Race reviews come from the PC's .ibt files. Garage 61 adds comparison laps, older history and teams.

decisions.title: Every push updates the tracking
decisions.text: After every push: the handoff and status docs, code map, history index, System Board, roadmap doc, Whiteboard and Paddock are brought up to date in the same chat.
